subtitle.actual: Measured from job card durations where a valid one exists. Every other figure is an assumption and is named as one
subtitle.estimated: Nothing measured in this view. Figures marked assumed are a model, not a record

banner.title: Measured and assumed figures are shown separately.
banner.bodyActual: Measured hours come only from job cards with a valid opened and completed time (under 720 hours, dated from 2000, not in the future), averaged per asset. A tyre event on an asset with no such job card has no measured downtime; the model assumes Critical 4h, High 3h, otherwise 2h for it. The headline tiles show measured values only and N/A where nothing was measured. Charts and the vehicle table use the assumed model and say so. Hourly rate: {rate} {basis}. A shift day is {shiftHours} hours.
banner.bodyEstimated: No job card with a valid opened and completed time matches these events, so nothing is measured and the headline tiles read N/A. The model assumes Critical 4h, High 3h, otherwise 2h per tyre event; charts and the vehicle table use that model and say so. Hourly rate: {rate} {basis}. A shift day is {shiftHours} hours.
banner.basisDefault: (no rate is set, so cost is not shown; add a "downtime_rate" key in Settings)

recommendations.heading: Improvement Recommendations
recommendations.vehicleMessage: Vehicle {asset} has had {count} downtime events - root cause investigation recommended
recommendations.vehicleAction: Perform full vehicle inspection, alignment check and driver behaviour review.
recommendations.siteMessage: Site {site} is {pct}% above average downtime - maintenance process review needed
recommendations.siteAction: Audit maintenance schedules, inspect tyre storage conditions and review fitment procedures.
recommendations.criticalMessage: {pct}% of events are Critical - predictive maintenance could reduce unplanned events by ~40%
recommendations.criticalAction: Implement weekly pressure monitoring, increase inspection frequency and set up tyre replacement schedule based on km thresholds.
recommendations.availabilityMessage: Fleet availability is {pct}% - below the {target}% industry benchmark
recommendations.availabilityAction: Review tyre lifecycle management, increase preventive replacements and track tread depth more frequently.
recommendations.okMessage: Fleet downtime is within acceptable range for current period
recommendations.okAction: Continue current maintenance schedule. Monitor monthly for early trend detection.
